description: This is a shell script defining a function 'is_private' which determines whether a given IP address belongs to a private network range (e.g., 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, or 172.16.x.x to 172.31.x.x). It includes license and copyright notices from Cisco and RDK Management.

methods.name: is_private
methods.description: Function that takes an IP address as input and returns whether it is a private IP address by setting the return code accordingly.
